title: helianthemum croceum subsp. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum croceum subsp. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species within the Cistaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing, soothing skin irritations, and reducing fever. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids have been identified in this plant, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is necessary to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
